raw: {"status": "NO_PLAN", "reasons": ["CS3247 requires CS3241, which is not in the mandatory list but must be added as a prerequisite. CS3241 is offered only in Sem 1 (odd semesters). CS3247 is offered only in Sem 2 (even semesters). To take CS3247 in Sem 6, CS3241 must be taken in Sem 5 or earlier. CS2105 must be taken before ST2334. ST2334 is required. CS4248 requires ST2334. CS4248 must be taken after ST2334. The student is on leave in Sem 8. Thus CS4248 must be in Sem 7 or earlier. If ST2334 is in Sem 5, CS4248 can be in Sem 6 or 7. If ST2334 is in Sem 6, CS4248 must be in Sem 7. The student requires at least 2 modules in any semester with courses. Sem 7 would only contain CS4248 (4 MC) if ST2334 is in Sem 6, or CS4248 and potentially others if ST2334 is in Sem 5. However, if ST2334 is in Sem 5, CS2105 must be in Sem 5 or earlier. Sem 5 would then have CS2105, CS3241, ST2334 (3 modules). Sem 6 has CS3219, CS2102, CS3247 (3 modules). Sem 7 has CS4248 (1 module). This violates the 'at least 2 modules' rule for Sem 7. If ST2334 is in Sem 6, Sem 7 has only CS4248, violating the rule. No valid plan exists that satisfies the minimum module count per active semester for all remaining courses."}
